title: Super Realistic
description: A minecraft that you have never seen before.
body:
This Modpack makes Minecraft super realistic by Adding shaders and using a Ressource pack for High resolution models, adds phisics with Phisics mod, adds new structures with 
qraftyfied STRUCTURES and new Biomes with terralith. But still keeps stable performance with optimization mods like sodium and voxy. If you notice performance issues try turning down the shader settings and / or reduce the generation distance of voxy world gen.
